title: Locker Group Pty Ltd - acquisition of Melwire Pty Ltd

body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the following markets: - the market for the manufacture and supply of metal wire screening; and - the market for the manufacture and supply of wire conveyor belting.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that a substantial lessening of competition was not likely given the level of imports and countervailing power.
